doc.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995

title: Williams's first Basie job in Norfolk
summary: On the first job after Williams joined, Basie opened with 'What Am I Here For' at a Navy officers' dance.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. I remember the first job we played. The very first job we played when I joined the band. We left New York and we went down to Norfolk, Virginia. We stopped in Washington, D.C. and got some hot smokes.

Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Hot links and half smokes. And by the theater there, and then continued on down to get Howard, then continued on down. And we got there and that night all this Navy brass was there and it was an officer’s dance. And the old man sit down at the piano and started noodling, and finally opened up. And you know what he opened up with?
You know? I said uh huh, okay. [scats]
